learning_objective: 🎯 We will look up at the sky and see the magical shapes the clouds make!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Clouds look like soft, white cotton balls floating high up in the blue sky.
If you look closely, clouds can look like animals, castles, or funny faces!
The wind blows the clouds across the sky, making them change shapes.

fun_activity.title: ☁️ Cotton Cloud Art
fun_activity.instructions: Take a blue paper and glue some soft cotton balls on it to make your own shapes of clouds!

quick_recap: ⭐ Clouds float high up in the blue sky.
⭐ They can look like fun shapes and animals.
⭐ The wind pushes them to make a beautiful show.
